source.passage:
The ASDP CSA Information shall identify and include the following:

3.6.1 For each assembly, subassembly, part, or component installed in the end item at time of delivery to the Government, shall include: a. Part number and revision. (1) Mission Design Series (MDS) (2) Part name. (3) Nomenclature. (4) Serial number (SN). (5) Lot number. (6) Associated Work Breakdown Structure (WBS) ID (7) Manufacturer and manufacture date, if the part is a Critical Safety Item (CSI), Safety Critical Item (SCI) (see 3.12 for definition), or both. In addition, manufacturer and manufacture date shall be included for any age or date managed life limited item. If not a CSI or age or date managed life limited item, installation date shall be provided, if available. If the installation date is not available, the Department of Defense (DD) Form 250, Material Inspection and Receiving Report, date shall be provided. (Copies of this form are available online at https://www.esd.whs.mil/Directives/forms.) (8) Vendor Commercial and Government Entity (CAGE) Code. (9) Manufacturing CAGE Code (if different than Vendor CAGE Code) (10) NHA part number, CAGE Code, and SN. (11) Airworthiness Directive(s) identifier (ID), if applicable. (12) Service Bulletin(s) ID, if applicable. (13) Software part number and revision, as applicable, for each SN-controlled unit. (14) Computer Program Identification Number (CPIN). (15) Applicable Technical Manuals and Technical Orders ID and their revisions. (16) Mark any item that has been determined to be a CSI “Y”. If not, mark “N”. (17) National Stock Number (NSN). (18) Identifier of warrantied item. (19) Unique Identifier of drawing/model used to develop, acquire, or purchase the part. (20) Unique Identifier of the direct Specification the PN was derived, or equivalent (e.g. Part Spec, Source Control Document (SCD), etc.).

(21) Location(s) of part (e.g. water line, buttock line, or station line)

wording: The ASDP Indentured Parts List shall provide the delivered-item identification and traceability fieldset in section 3.6.1(a), covering part number and revision, mission/design and item names, serial and lot identifiers, WBS link, conditional manufacture or installation/receiving dates, vendor/manufacturer and next-higher-assembly identifiers, applicable directives and software/manual references, CSI marking, stock and warranty identifiers, drawing/specification trace, and part locations.
condition: When DI-SESS-82333B is invoked by the applicable contract or CDRL; for each assembly, subassembly, part, or component installed in the end item at delivery to the Government; manufacturer and manufacture date apply to CSI, SCI, or both, and to any age/date-managed life-limited item; preserve the exact later branch "If not a CSI or age or date managed life limited item" for installation date if available, followed by DD Form 250 date if installation date is unavailable; manufacturing CAGE applies if different from vendor CAGE; Airworthiness Directives and Service Bulletins apply if applicable; software part number/revision applies as applicable to each serial-number-controlled unit; CSI marking is Y if determined CSI and N otherwise; the source NA-field rule remains applicable.
notes: Operative DID data-product requirement, binding only when actually invoked by the applicable contract/CDRL and within the source conditions. Coherent content lists are grouped; product classes, installed-part instances, and individual subfields do not multiply records. Composite quotation: separate exact spans are separated by blank lines, with intervening text or page furniture omitted; no claim of consecutive prose. Span PDF pages: 1,2,3. Every span matches the opened source PDF text by cited page after NFC and layout-whitespace collapse. One coherent delivered-item fieldset, not 21 requirements or one per part type. The source negative date branch does not repeat SCI: an SCI-only item can meet the first manufacturer/manufacture-date condition and the later non-CSI/non-life-limited date condition. The omission is preserved, not silently repaired. DD Form 250 is cited only as the date source; no form content is extracted. WBS ID is an express native field here. CSI Y/N is not an invented SCI Y/N enum. Part/specification/location examples are not sample rows.
